<action type="say">
Here’s how to get your Air Canada confirmation re‑sent to tom.kowalski@buffalony.gov.

You’ll need:
- Confirmation code: AC7P4Z2  
- Last name: Trebek  

On Air Canada’s website (desktop or mobile browser)

1) Go to: https://www.aircanada.com  
2) At the top, click “My Bookings” (sometimes “My Bookings / Check‑in”).  
3) Under “Find a booking” (or similar wording), choose the option to search by:
   - “Booking reference (PNR)” or “Confirmation number”  
   - Last name  
4) Enter:
   - Booking reference / confirmation: AC7P4Z2  
   - Last name: Trebek  
   Then click “Find” or “Retrieve booking”.

Once your booking opens:

5) Look for a section labeled “Passenger details,” “Contact information,” or a small “Edit”/“Modify” link near your name or email.  
6) If your old email is shown, change it to:
   - tom.kowalski@buffalony.gov  
   Save or confirm the change.

To resend the confirmation:

7) On the same booking page, look for a button or link such as:
   - “Email itinerary,” “Send itinerary,” “Send confirmation,” or an envelope/email icon.  
8) Click that, confirm the email address shown is tom.kowalski@buffalony.gov, and send.  
   - If it lets you type an address, manually enter tom.kowalski@buffalony.gov and send.

Optional (if you use the Air Canada app instead)

1) Open the app → tap “Trips” or “My bookings.”  
2) If the trip doesn’t appear automatically, add it using:
   - Booking reference: AC7P4Z2  
   - Last name: Trebek  
3) Open the trip → look for “Contact details” to update the email, then a “Share” or “Email itinerary” option to send the confirmation to tom.kowalski@buffalony.gov.

If any of the labels look different or you don’t see an “Email itinerary” option, tell me exactly what you see on the screen (or the headings/buttons), and I’ll adjust the steps for that layout.</action>
